description: Announce a product launch, release, or update with a press release. PRICE: $1 USDC per call. Use when the user says things like "announce my launch", "write a press release", "publish a press release for my product", "announce our new version". Given a product URL, Agent Press Wire drafts a factual 350-450 word AP-style press release from the page and publishes it on a public, search-indexed newsroom page (IndexNow ping to Bing/Yandex). Returns the headline, newsroom URL, and the release in markdown. About 20 seconds. If the user already wrote the release, pass it as headline + body and it is published as written after the service's safety checks. Pictures: the page's og:image is used by default; pass image_url to choose one, and with your own copy up to 3 inline images. For distribution to real news sites, use distribute_press_release instead. Charges REAL USDC on Base mainnet from the user's own wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) via x402. Two steps: call first WITHOUT confirm_token (or with quote_only=true) to get the price and a confirm_token; show the user the exact price and get explicit approval; then call again with identical parameters and that confirm_token (single use, expires in 10 minutes). It only pays if the price is <= MAX_SPEND_USD, the lifetime total stays <= MAX_TOTAL_SPEND_USD, and the server's payment terms match the pinned Agent Press Wire wallet and price; otherwise it returns the quote without paying. The service only settles payment if the job succeeds.

announcement.description: What is being announced (launch, new version, feature, funding, milestone). Strongly recommended: without it only news visible on the page is written about, and the call fails uncharged if there is none.

body.description: Bring your own copy (optional, together with headline): the finished release text in English, plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines, 150 to 900 words (380 to 900 for wire tiers), at most 5 links and only to the product's own site. Omit headline and body to have the release drafted from the page.

confirm_token.description: confirm_token from a previous quote of this tool with the exact same parameters, passed only after the user approved the quoted price. Without it the call only quotes.

contact.description: Optional media contact line (name, email or URL) printed at the end.

headline.description: Bring your own copy (optional, together with body): the finished headline, 3 to 20 words, naming the announcing company. When headline and body are given the service publishes or distributes the text as written instead of drafting; it still runs the same safety checks (prohibited topics, market-moving claims on wire tiers, links only to the product's own site, brand must match the page, model safety review) and fails uncharged with reasons if they do not pass.

image_alt.description: Optional alt text for the featured picture, max 125 characters (defaults to the headline).

image_caption.description: Optional caption under the featured picture, max 300 characters.

image_url.description: Optional featured picture: a public http(s) URL or a data:image/png|jpeg|webp|gif;base64 URI, PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 1 MB. Without it the service uses the product page's og:image picture unless no_image is true. Every picture is safety reviewed before charging (no nudity, violence, hate symbols, other companies' logos, money or health claims, news-site screenshots, hidden instructions); a supplied picture that fails returns an uncharged error with the reason, a page picture that fails is just left out.

images.description: Only with your own headline and body: up to 3 pictures placed inside the release, at lines [image 1], [image 2], [image 3] in the body (or spread evenly if there are no marker lines). Same formats, limit and safety review as image_url.

url.description: http(s) URL or data:image/...;base64 URI, max 1 MB.

no_image.description: Optional: true to publish without a picture (turns off the automatic picture from the product page).

product_url.description: Public URL of the product, launch page, or repo being announced.

quote_only.description: If true, never pay: just return the x402 price quote and a confirm_token. Use this first to show the user the price.
